notes.title: Houdini 20.5 is released!
notes.notes:
Everyone at SideFX is pleased to announce the release of Houdini 20.5.

Houdini 20.5 includes hundreds of new workflows and improvements including the MPM solver for solid mechanics, Copernicus for image processing, Quick Surface Materials for access to Material X, and new rigging and animation tools.

Modeling & UX
Modeling tools include an updated Clip, a new Planar Inflate and Point Cloud tools. New UX enhancements include the Node Info Window and Recipes.

VFX
The new MPM Solver lets you simulate materials such as snow, soil, mud, and more. There is also a new RBD Car Rig. 

Copernicus
Explore the new 2D and 3D GPU-based image framework designed to create procedural texture maps, NPR/toon shading, and Slap Comps.

Character Animation
Starting with Animation Layers, enjoy a suite of new animation tools designed to streamline the keyframing of character motion.

Character Rigging
Discover the magic of tags which make it easier to set up procedural character and creature rigs using pre-built rig components. 

Lookdev
Use new Solaris workflows for layout, lookdev, and lighting then render with Karma XPU which now has Adaptive Sampling which makes it faster. 

Houdini Indie 20.5 is available today (July 11th) on Steam. 
Steam users can update Houdini Indie from their Steam Library to use Houdini Indie 20.5 now.

[url=https://www.sidefx.com/products/whats-new-in-h205/]What's new in Houdini 20.5 ?[/url]

notes.title: Houdini 20 is released!
notes.notes:
SideFX is pleased to announce the release of Houdini 20.0.

Houdini 20 includes hundreds of enhancements and new workflows including Karma XPU, Feathers, Clouds, Material Catalog, Render Stats, Quad Remesh, APEX Character Rigging & Animation tools, and more. 

ANIMATION
Explore APEX, a brand-new context designed to deliver an animator-friendly environment that is built on a robust procedural rigging toolset.

CHARACTER FX
Check out the new Feather tools which complement the fur, cloth, muscles, and crowd tools available for CFX artists.

KARMA XPU
Karma XPU is production-ready and works with new Solaris tools such as the material linker, Material X galleries, and shot clones.

ENVIRONMENTS
New Cloud tools combine with terrain and ocean tools to create complete environments for your movies and video games.

VFX
Lots of improvements such as the new Ripple solver and Rigid Body Cone Twist handles enhance the quality-of-life for FX artists.

MESHING
New tools such as Quad Remesh, Topoflow, LIDAR Import, and Point Cloud Surface, allow you to work more efficiently while you manage high-resolution geometry.

notes.title: Installing SideFX Labs Tools in Houdini 19.5 on Steam
notes.notes:
There have been some problems with installing SideFX Labs tools in Houdini 19.5 on Steam. 
Follow these workaround steps to install the tools.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Here is a short guide to manually downloading the latest version of SideFXLabs and installing it into your local packages directory.

First, download the latest version of SideFXLabs from the git repo using this link:
https://github.com/sideeffects/SideFXLabs/archive/refs/heads/Development.zip

---

TL;DR
1. Extract the zip file into your ~/Documents/houdini19.5/packages folder (create if doesn't exist).
(MacOS) Extract the zip file into your ~/Library/Preferences/houdini/19.5/packages folder (create if doesn't exist).
2. Rename the extracted folder from 'SideFXLabs-Development' to 'SideFXLabs19.5'
3. Move the SideFXLabs19.5/SideFXLabs.json file up to the packages directory
4. Restart Houdini
5. Enjoy!

---
NOTE: MacOS users will find their Houdini User Preferences folder located at ~/Library/Preferences/houdini/19.5 

Step by step instructions for Windows users:

On Windows, your Houdini User Preferences folder is located at ~/Documents/houdini19.5/ and you can get there quickly with file explorer by entering %USERPROFILE% and pressing enter which will take you there automatically.  

Once there you can browse into the 'Documents folder', then find the 'houdini19.5' directoy under that.
This folder holds your local user configuration data for Houdini.
It's going to look something like this 'C:\Users\<user>\Documents\houdini19.5' for Windows users.

Within that 'houdini19.5' directory, create a sub-directory named 'packages' and then extract the downloaded SideFXLabs-Development.zip file into the 'packages' directory.

Under 'packages' you should now have 'SideFXLabs-Development' directory

(IMPORTANT) : rename 'SideFXLabs-Development' to 'SideFXLabs19.5'

Inside the 'SideFXLabs19.5' directory, you will find a 'SideFXLabs.json' file

(IMPORTANT) : move the SideFXLabs.json file into the parent 'packages' folder

Restart Houdini and you should now have access to the latest Labs tools.

notes.title: Houdini 19.5 Released!
notes.notes:
SideFX is pleased to announce the release of Houdini 19.5 which is available for download today. 

Houdini 19.5 focuses on improving the quality of life for artists throughout the Houdini community. Whether you work on feature films, television, video games or motion graphics, Houdini 19.5 brings you new and enhanced tools to meet your most demanding production requirements.

Houdini 19.5 includes hundreds of improvements and new workflows including a new SOP-based FLIP Solver workflow, the curve state now supports orientation handles, Solaris has a render region and new Layout tools for stacking and placing objects along a line. 

Karma CPU now supports nested dialetrics and Karma XPU moves to beta and includes Sub Surface Scattering. A new Dashbox widget can be used for fast global search, and support for partial presets and macros.

Houdini Indie 19.5 is available today (July. 20th) on Steam. Steam users can update Houdini Indie from their Steam Library to use Houdini Indie 19.5 now.

notes.title: Dropping Python 2 in Houdini 19.5
notes.notes:
SideFX will discontinue Python 2 support in Houdini 19.5 and beyond. You can view the news post in SideFX's forum here: [url=https://www.sidefx.com/forum/topic/83757/]https://www.sidefx.com/forum/topic/83757/  [/url] 

"After countless internal discussions, and discussions with studios and technology partners, the decision has been made to drop Python 2 support in the upcoming Houdini release.

Python 2 reached end-of-life back in January, 2020:
[url=https://www.python.org/doc/sunset-python-2/]https://www.python.org/doc/sunset-python-2/[/url]

The next Houdini version will provide only Python 3 builds, in particular Python 3.7 and 3.9 builds as per the VFX Reference Platform.
[url=http://vfxplatform.com/]http://vfxplatform.com/[/url]

Note that we will continue to publish Python 2 builds for Houdini 19.0."

notes.title: Houdini Game Jam 2020
notes.notes:
SideFX is proud to announce the first-ever Houdini Game Jam! Everyone is invited to participate in the jam and use Houdini to make games for a chance at winning awesome prizes.

Houdini Game Jam will take place over the course of one week from August 14th to August 21st, 2020. The game jam will begin when the theme is revealed via livestream on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/sidefxofficial]SideFX’s Twitch channel[/url] at 11am PST on August 14th. Game jammers will then have one week to build their games and submit them before the deadline of 5pm PST on August 21st. 

Game jammers are encouraged to use the hashtag #HoudiniGameJam20 for social media posts about their game development. Finished games will be entered via the [url=https://itch.io/jam/houdini-game-jam-2020]Houdini Game Jam page on itch.io[/url]. The eligible game entries will be played by the judges and prizes will be awarded to the 1st, 2nd, and 3rd place winning teams. 

SideFX is offering free 2-month Houdini Indie licenses for game jammers to use for HGJ.[url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSenCK5qt40ojPYskOCK6YP9Jiu1wnBliiYwYJRG41OdgGnZ2Q/viewform] You can request a temporary Houdini Indie license here [/url]

SideFX has also created a [url=https://www.sidefx.com/tutorials/game-jam-starter-kit/]"Game Jam Starter Kit"[/url] to provide pre-built procedural assets for game jammers to use in Unreal Engine and Unity.

[url=https://www.sidefx.com/community-main-menu/houdini-game-jam-2020/]You can view the full Houdini Game Jam details here.[/url]

notes.title: Houdini 17.5 Released
notes.notes:
SideFX is proud to announce the release of Houdini 17.5.  Whether you are a feature film VFX artist, a game developer or a small studio, Houdini 17.5 brings you new and enhanced tools to meet your most demanding production requirements. 

Houdini 17.5 is an important release that includes:

[b]- NEW: Task Operator Network (TOPs)[/b]

    - Built with new Procedural Dependency Graph [PDG] technology
    - Automate and scale pipeline tasks, including FX pipelines
    - Describe and visualize dependencies to maximize compute efficiency
    - Distribute tasks intelligently using Local, HQueue, Deadline, or Tractor Schedulers
    - Nested wedging support to create many variants of data, such as models, simulations and more
    - Convenient shelf tools for typical wedging operations
    - Process Houdini Digital Assets (HDAs) in parallel
    - Create large scale procedural environments by chaining a system with HDAs
    - Bring unparalleled scale to Houdini Engine through the API extension for PDG
    - Automate applications such as Houdini and Maya using command chains
    - Higher level support for Mantra, Geo, and Alembic ROPs, with other ROPs also supported through the ROP Fetch node
    - Script, manage, and schedule work items using Python
    - Rich set of stock nodes to enhance pipeline functionality
      [list]
[*]   Data import and export using CSV, SQL, JSON, and XML nodes
[*]         Interface with Shotgun to bring in and manage assets
[*]         Create image mosaics using ImageMagick
[*]         Assemble frames into movies using ffmpeg
[*]         Integrate with asset management systems such as Perforce
[/list]
    - Communicate pipeline events to your team using the Send Email TOP
    - Standalone PilotPDG app for working exclusively with TOP networks

[b]- Fluids [/b]

    - Distributable FLIP narrow band and whitewater simulations
    - Highly accurate collision handling in FLIP pressure projection
    - Realtime path-traced Pyro visualization in the viewport
    - POP Fluid shelf tool for condensation

[b]- Vellum [/b]

    - Per-point cloth friction attribute
    - Multi-dimensional tetrahedral fibre constraints
    - Stiffness drop-off control
    - Streamlined generation of tetrahedral soft bodies
    - Stress visualization of all soft body types

[b]- RBD/Destruction[/b]

    - Massive speed gains and memory boost for rigid bodies with instanced geometry
    - Viewport-centric workflow for constraint setup and editing
    - Dedicated RBD Constraint SOPs
    - Time Scale parameter in Bullet solver
    - RBD Material Fracture 2.0: better edge detail handling for concrete destruction
    - Open surface support in Boolean Fracture SOP

[b]- Viewport [/b]

    - Realtime path-traced display of all volume types, with self-shadowing
    - Shader parity with Mantra's Principled shader and other software packages
    - High quality lighting improvements, including 3x frame rate for area lights
    - Object level Python support for interactive workflows
    - Browser/inspector panel for custom Python states
    - Better heuristics for near and far clipping planes
    - Better compositing of viewport passes for color correction with OpenColorIO and LUTs
    - Homing along construction plane normal

[b]- Modeling / Geometry[/b]

    - Ability to display and inspect the geometry of all outputs of a SOP
    - Fully redesigned Fuse SOP with new snapping and fusion capabilities
    - Powerful shape analysis and visualization via Measure SOP 2.0
    - Many feature and performance enhancements to BlendShapes SOP
    - Faster and feature-rich Exploded View SOP
    - Scatter SOP can now read density texture directly from COPs
    - Bound SOP computation of axis-aligned or freely-oriented bounding rectangle
    - More compiled SOPs such as File, Volume, and Cloud Light
    - Rotations in multiples of 90 degrees now handled with exact precision
    - Interactive selection by pattern or surface normal
    - Squash and stretch manipulator for non-uniform scaling
    - Construction planes in the orthographic viewport

[b]- Terrain[/b]

    - 70% less memory required for erosion
    - Freeform alpha cutouts with optional cropping
    - Enhancements to landscape I/O

[b]- GameDev[/b]

    - Blended linear and dual quaternion skinning for FBX I/O
    - AliceVision photogrammetry support
    - Dedicated hard surface shader for game developers
    - MikkT support in PolyFrame SOP
    - GLTF importer enhancements
    - UV Attribute Transfer SOP
    - Path deformer
    - Building generator
    - Spiral generator
    - Enhanced texture baker
    - Many other improvements to existing toolset

[b]- Rendering[/b]

    - 4x faster photon map acceleration structure
    - Simplified shader binding of texture coordinates
    - Light path expressions store unshadowed lighting contributions

There are many more new features in the new release.  Please refer to the What's New section in the Houdini 17.5 documentation for a more complete feature list: https://www.sidefx.com/docs/houdini17.5/news/17_5/index.html
